papers.title_en: XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Zuyi Guo, Xianjie Dai, Lei Yang, Xiaocong Zhao, Jingguang Li, Kitae Jang, Heye Huang
papers.evidence: 具备跨记忆推理的记忆增强LLM驾驶智能体
papers.tldr: 记忆增强LLM驾驶智能体虽能复用经验，但交通变化时既往修正难以迁移，且现有记忆多记录观测结果、缺少备选动作证据。XMind以无需训练框架融合近期交通状态的工作记忆与关键风险事件的情景记忆，先初判再交叉核验历史经验，冲突时依据检索证据二次决策。闭环高速仿真成功率达83.3%-93.3%，平均超强基线6.6个百分点，并在K-Risk上降低未见高风险交互的决策风险。其贡献在于用反事实验证构建风险胶囊，实现跨记忆“三思”式驾驶推理。
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented large language model (LLM) driving agents can reuse past experience, yet previously learned corrections often fail to transfer when traffic conditions change. A key limitation is that existing memories mainly record observed outcomes, providing little evidence about alternative actions. We introduce XMind, a training-free framework that enables LLM-based driving to "Think Twice" through cross-memory reasoning. XMind integrates working memory of recent traffic states with episodic memory of critical risk events. The agent first makes an initial decision from the current context and then cross-checks it against retrieved historical experience. If a conflict arises, it makes a second decision guided by the retrieved evidence. To construct reliable episodic memory, XMind evaluates alternative actions through counterfactual rollouts under perturbed traffic conditions and stores the verified outcomes as structured risk capsules. These capsules are retrieved by jointly matching spatial risk patterns and scenario semantics. Across closed-loop highway simulations, XMind achieves success rates of 83.3-93.3%, exceeding the strong baseline by 6.6 percentage points on average. Evaluation on K-Risk further demonstrates lower decision risk on unseen real-world high-risk interactions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary benefits of working memory, risk-text retrieval, and counterfactual verification. Code is available at https://github.com/xiangxiangliuwo/XMind

papers.title_en: From Local Errors to System Failures: Modeling and Benchmarking Error Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.authors: Wenlong Yu, Bingxu Lu, Qilong Wang, Qinghua Hu, Qianru Sun
papers.evidence: 建模并评测多智能体大模型系统的错误传播，支撑知识增强智能体鲁棒性评估
papers.tldr: 多智能体LLM中错误会沿中间消息传播并损害最终答案，结果评估却难揭示局部放大、衰减或纠正。本文提出REPA结构模型，分离输入组装与智能体处理的误差通道，并理论关联局部与端点误差。在ErrPropBench-10的3个Qwen基座、6种工作流和10类设置上，REPA条件级Spearman均值0.84，直接回归仅0.47；REPA引导RAG平均提19个百分点、仅增16% token。该工作关联局部行为与系统脆弱性，为误差传播与定向优化奠基。
papers.abstract_en: In multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs), errors can propagate through intermediate messages and compromise final answers. However, outcome-based evaluation obscures how agents amplify, attenuate, or correct these errors. We propose Response-Aware Error Propagation among Agents (REPA), a structural model that connects measured local responses to system-level error propagation. REPA separately estimates input assembly and agent processing across multiple error channels, while theoretical analysis relates local modeling errors to endpoint prediction error. Experiments span three Qwen base models, six MAS workflows, and ten knowledge and reasoning settings in ErrPropBench-10. REPA achieves a mean condition-level Spearman correlation of 0.84 across base models, compared with 0.47 for direct regression. Controlled experiments also demonstrate its utility for targeted recovery. REPA-guided retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves accuracy over no retrieval by an average of 19 percentage points with 16% additional tokens. By linking local agent behavior to system susceptibility, REPA provides an interpretable foundation for studying error propagation and developing targeted optimization in MAS.

papers.title_en: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
papers.authors: Aryan Jain, Abhishek Jha, Anish Nediyanchath, Promod Yenigalla
papers.evidence: 以节点与边构成的双图记忆支撑个性化智能体
papers.tldr: 现有长期记忆架构多记录用户经历过什么，却把为何如此的推理留给底层LLM，难以沉淀行为模式。STARK提出双图记忆：情节图按时间、因果和语义链接交互事件，洞察图存储LLM抽取的行为信号并以支持事件计分、用事件作边连接。推理时直接从洞察节点检索行为知识，并以事件边落地，避免重复遍历情节图；事件边还可将知识图谱投影到关系嵌入空间，实现共享情境下的跨用户迁移与冷启动补全。在LongMemEval、LoCoMo和LongLaMP上，STARK均优于现有方法并验证跨用户迁移收益。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.

papers.title_en: Your Diffusion-Based Driving Planner Only Needs a Nudge
papers.authors: Zilin Wang, Guozheng Ma, Saeed Rahmani, Jiong Yang, Antyanta Bangunharcana, Yiluan Guo, Jakob Nicolaus Foerster, Shimon Whiteson
papers.evidence: 基于扩散模型的驾驶规划器，用强化学习轻推策略提升闭环安全性
papers.tldr: 基于扩散的驾驶规划器能捕捉多模态行为，但闭环执行存在协变量偏移，易产生碰撞或偏离道路。PlanNudge冻结预训练扩散规划器，仅训练轻量MLP nudge策略，每步输出对速度和曲率的二维微调。在nuPlan六个设置中匹配或超越先前SOTA RL微调，环境步数约1/6、模型计算不足1/5。表明小调整即可安全后训练，并给出离策略RL实践建议。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based planners capture the multimodality of human driving behavior well, yet covariate shift in closed-loop driving can lead them to generate trajectories that result in collisions or road departures. Reinforcement learning (RL) finetuning offers a promising way to tackle this issue, but applying it to diffusion-based planners is complicated by their iterative denoising process and receding-horizon execution. We find that small adjustments to the planned trajectories can prevent many of these unsafe outcomes. Motivated by this observation, we propose PlanNudge, which preserves the learned planning capabilities of a pretrained diffusion-based planner by freezing it and trains a lightweight policy that we call the nudge policy. At each planning step, the nudge policy outputs a nudge, a two-dimensional adjustment of the speed and curvature of the plan from the frozen planner. The nudge policy is a multilayer perceptron that predicts the nudge in a single forward pass, and both dimensions directly change the motion of the vehicle, so standard off-policy RL can train it in closed-loop simulation. We evaluate PlanNudge on nuPlan, a large-scale autonomous driving benchmark based on real-world driving data. In all six settings, PlanNudge matches or exceeds the final scores of the previous state-of-the-art RL finetuning method while using about one sixth as many environment steps and less than one fifth as much model compute. We also provide guidelines for reward shaping, value learning, and exploration when using off-policy RL to post-train autonomous driving planners. Our results are reported with means and standard deviations over six training runs. Project page: https://zerlinwang.github.io/plannudge/

papers.title_en: Cache the Knowledge, Not Just the Prompt: Dynamic Datalog as the Action Language for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Bruno Rucy Carneiro Alves de Lima, Victor Henrique Cabral Pinheiro
papers.evidence: LLM智能体借助缓存Datalog求值查询知识图谱
papers.tldr: LLM代理回答知识图谱问题时每次从头写程序并重算，难以复用会话知识。论文让代理使用动态Datalog REPL，规则可像事实一样插入/撤回且派生事实保持最新，从而缓存知识而不仅是提示。在三个知识图谱的连续问答中，REPL在180次里179次复用关系，输出token比SQL/Python代理少23%–82%。这为代理提供可读且随数据更新保持正确的行动语言。
papers.abstract_en: An LLM agent that answers questions about a knowledge graph writes a program per question, and its tools evaluate each from scratch. We give the agent a Datalog REPL, a session over a dynamic Datalog engine, in which rules are inserted and retracted like facts while derived facts stay current. Prompt caching reuses the model's processing of what a session shares, and the Datalog REPL reuses the evaluation of it. On chains of questions over three knowledge graphs, agents reuse a relation that the REPL keeps in 179 of 180 cases, with two models, and write fewer output tokens: SQL and Python agents write 23 to 82% more. With SQL tables or a Python namespace, Claude Haiku 5.5 stores almost nothing for later questions, and a chain of seven questions at 13 million facts takes it a median of 48 and 56 s, against 31 s with the REPL. Claude Opus 5.5 matches the REPL by storing tables in SQL, and when the data changes it stores views, which are evaluated again at every read. A relation that the REPL keeps is read like a table and stays current like a view. Datalog is a niche language beside SQL and Python, and with thinking enabled the models answer as accurately with it.

papers.title_en: SAGE-Drive: Benefit-Aware Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving Planning
papers.authors: Donglei Rong, Wenbin Yao, Congcong Bai, Xi Gao, Qiaoqiao Ren, Sheng Jin, Cheng Xu
papers.evidence: 面向自动驾驶规划的自适应显式推理框架
papers.tldr: 显式推理能帮助自动驾驶理解复杂交互，但收益随场景变化且计算开销高。SAGE-Drive用无推理初始轨迹的几何特征和多模态场景信息预测推理收益，并在预算内只对高收益场景启用显式推理。实验显示显式推理仅53.5%场景提升精度，20%预算下ADE为1.5191米，35%预算下接近全量推理。该工作将预测收益作为推理选择准则，以少量计算获得接近全量推理的规划精度。
papers.abstract_en: Explicit reasoning enables autonomous vehicles (AVs) to interpret complex traffic interactions and support trajectory planning, but introduces additional computational demands. Determining when explicit reasoning can improve planning accuracy remains a key challenge, as its benefits vary across driving scenarios. To address this challenge, this study proposes Scene-Adaptive Gating of Explicit Reasoning for Driving (SAGE-Drive), a benefit-aware adaptive reasoning framework for autonomous driving planning. First, paired planning outcomes with and without explicit reasoning are analyzed to measure the reasoning benefit, i.e., the reduction in planning error achieved by explicit reasoning, which serves as the supervision label. SAGE-Drive then learns to predict these benefits using geometric features of the initial trajectory planned without reasoning and multimodal scene information, and invokes explicit reasoning only for the scenarios with the highest predicted benefits under a predefined reasoning budget. Experiments on 1,497 paired driving scenarios reveal that explicit reasoning improves planning accuracy in 53.5% of cases while degrading it in 46.5%, yielding a near-zero average benefit. On the test set, with a 20% reasoning budget, SAGE-Drive achieves an average displacement error (ADE) of 1.5191 m, compared with 1.5252 m for random selection. At a 35% budget, it achieves an ADE of 1.5148 m, close to the 1.5141 m obtained when reasoning is applied to every scenario. These findings establish the predicted reasoning benefit as an effective criterion for reasoning selection, allowing explicit reasoning to be invoked where it improves planning accuracy at a fraction of its computational cost.

papers.title_en: Coordinating Perception and Planning for Test-Time Adaptation in End-to-End Driving under Distribution Shifts
papers.authors: Shiyu Fang, Yiming Cui, Qihang Huang, Zhan Chen, Collister Chua, Wenhui Huang, Peng Hang, Chen Lv, Jian Sun
papers.evidence: 在端到端驾驶中协同感知与规划的测试时自适应框架
papers.tldr: 端到端自动驾驶依赖i.i.d.假设，真实分布偏移下易退化，测试时适应又受感知-规划耦合与长时更新漂移制约。本文提出P2-TTA，联合感知熵最小化与基于自车运动的历史规划一致性目标，并用EMA教师和历史规划损失拒绝机制稳定更新。在多个骨干上仅更新约0.11‰参数、平均19.9ms，严重偏移下L2、碰撞率、PDMS平均恢复率达36.4%、30.0%、9.3%。该即插即用框架为端到端驾驶持续测试时适应提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved significant milestones, yet its reliance on the i.i.d. assumption renders it vulnerable to real-world distribution shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising paradigm for on-the-fly enhancement, its application to driving is hindered by two barriers: (i) multi-task adaptation dependency, where updates to upstream perception also affect downstream planning, while perception confidence alone does not directly assess these downstream effects; and (ii) continuous adaptation instability, where recursive online updates over long horizons cause compounding parameter drift. To address these challenges, we propose P2-TTA, a plug-and-play TTA framework for the continual adaptation of end-to-end driving models. P2-TTA coordinates adaptation through a joint objective combining perception entropy minimization with a retrospective temporal planning consistency objective derived from observed ego motion. To stabilize online updates, we use an EMA teacher as a moving parameter reference and reject candidate updates that increase historical planning loss. Extensive experiments across multiple models demonstrate that, by updating an average of 0.11 per mille of parameters with an average adaptation time of 19.9 ms on different backbones, P2-TTA achieves average recovery rates of 36.4%, 30.0%, and 9.3% for L2, collision rate, and PDMS, respectively, under severe distribution shifts. Under a shared perception-planning objective, P2-TTA achieves the highest L2 and collision recovery among the compared TTA baselines on UniAD.

papers.title_en: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
papers.authors: Seongchan Kim, Soowon Son, Sangoh Kim, Hyunah Ko, Eunbeen Hong, Hyunkoo Lee, Sanghyun Lee, WonJun Moon, Kihong Kim, Dongyeon Son, Woongchan Nam, Seungryong Kim
papers.evidence: 保留场景理解与轨迹预测的驾驶VLA模型结构化剪枝
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶VLA依赖思维链推理指导动作，却面临高内存与计算开销。作者分析Alpamayo-1.5-10B的Taylor重要性，发现推理与轨迹目标偏好不同VLM结构，进而提出MoOP：联合两类目标排序剪枝VLM，并聚合去噪步重要性选择动作专家MLP通道。24%参数削减下驾驶性能持平或略优且保留94.0% LingoQA，30%削减时推理不崩溃；总削减39.4%仍获1.37倍加速和36.6%峰值内存下降，且无需剪枝后微调。该方法为自动驾驶VLA的高效部署提供了可复用的结构化剪枝思路。
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Zehua Fan, Qi Jiang, Wei Li, Kai Tang, Yue Jiang, Yujian Li, Bailin Li, Feng Gao, Yan Wang, Kun Zhan
papers.evidence: 面向场景理解与动作预测的端到端多模态驾驶框架
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶需语义理解与细粒度感知，但VLA受低维动作标签监督不足，视觉生成或世界动作模型又引入与规划弱相关的外观重建开销。NativeDrive基于原生多模态统一骨干构建无编码器驾驶框架，用Native Action Interface复用理解专家做离散策略、适配生成专家做连续策略。训练时以Driving Semantic Editing复用生成编辑能力提供稠密场景结构监督，推理仅运行所选规划策略。在NAVSIM v1/v2上取得统一理解-生成模型中有竞争力的规划表现，消融验证组件有效。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving requires semantic understanding and fine-grained scene perception for precise action prediction. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic priors, but low-dimensional action labels provide limited structural supervision. Some studies extend VLAs with visual generation tasks or adopt video-based world-action models (WAMs), but both approaches introduce appearance-reconstruction overhead, which is less relevant to planning. Native multimodal models offer an alternative to unify understanding and generation within one backbone. On this basis, we propose NativeDrive, a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework adapting the unified backbone for policy learning and introduce a dense supervision task tailored to driving. The Native Action Interface reuses the understanding expert's token-prediction interface for the discrete policy and adapts the generation expert for continuous policy. Driving Semantic Editing reuses the generation expert's editing capability for dense scene-structure supervision during training, while inference runs only the selected planning policy. NativeDrive achieves competitive planning performance among unified understanding-and-generation models on NAVSIM v1 and v2, with ablations validating its components' effectiveness. Code will be released.

papers.title_en: GeoVLDrive: Geometry-Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: JiaHui Huang, Songyan Zhang, Hanbing Li, Hanchao Leng, Kuiyuan Yang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Chen Lv
papers.evidence: 面向自动驾驶推理与规划的视觉-语言-动作规划器
papers.tldr: 现有视觉-语言-动作规划器虽继承了预训练模型的语义知识，但其推理很少扎根于三维场景结构及其时序演化。GeoVLDrive 通过门控交叉注意力把三维基础模型的多层特征注入视觉语言主干，并用结构化隐式思维链依次监督未来场景几何、关键智能体运动与元动作，再由动作专家生成轨迹并基于场景打分排序。在 NAVSIM v1/v2 上分别取得 91.8 PDMS 与 90.9 EPDMS，几何主干在 NAVSIM 3DQA 上达 89.2%。该工作让 VLA 规划真正建立在可度量的三维时空理解之上。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) planners inherit semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models, but their reasoning is rarely grounded in 3D scene structure and its evolution over time. We introduce GeoVLDrive, a geometry-grounded VLA framework for 3D spatiotemporal reasoning and planning. Multi-layer features from a 3D foundation model augment the vision-language backbone through gated cross-attention. A structured latent chain of thought (CoT) organizes future scene geometry, key-agent motion, and meta-actions into ordered, separately supervised latent states. An action expert generates trajectory proposals from these states and multi-layer scene features, and ranks them using scene-grounded, interacting score tokens. We also introduce NAVSIM 3DQA to train and evaluate metric 3D spatial and motion understanding. GeoVLDrive achieves 91.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. On NAVSIM 3DQA, the geometry-grounded backbone scores 89.2% overall, 4.6 percentage points above the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B baseline. On LingoQA, the backbone achieves 68.6% Lingo-Judge accuracy.

papers.title_en: Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Nhat Ha Nguyen, Sudipta Chowdhury, Lokesh Das
papers.evidence: 驾驶视觉语言模型证据充分性与弃答的基准评测
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶视觉语言模型不仅要答对，还需判断视觉证据是否足以支撑回答。DriveAnswer构建20,151道题，用强/弱证据配对区分可回答与应弃答，并要求完整定位证据。最强零样本强证据准确率67.31%，但仅21.55%配对题同时满足正确弃答与完整定位；受控适配后Gemma-4-12B联合能力达63.29%。这表明语义正确、证据充分性与定位是应联合评估的不同能力。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.
